SUPPORT & ESCALATION

How to ask for help
clearly.

Use this page for the general support model. Coverage hours and response targets are those written into your client or partner agreement—not generic website promises.

Plan your projectExplore services

REQUESTING SUPPORT

What to provide.

Contact the channel named in your agreement, or operations@hdocks.com or the enquiry form for pre-contract questions. Include impact, location, affected systems/users, recent changes, and any ticket or work-order reference.

URGENCY AND ESCALATION

How HeyDock assesses priority.

We assess urgency from business impact, safety/risk, number of users affected, and whether a workaround exists. Escalation follows the contacts named for your engagement (for example service desk → technical lead → account owner). Partners retain end-customer communication unless the work order says otherwise.

COVERAGE COMMITMENTS

Where they are defined.

Support hours, on-site attendance targets, penalties and 24/7 cover are not advertised as universal website promises. They are set out only in the agreement that applies to your account. If no agreement exists yet, an enquiry starts a scoping discussion only.
